el.Un espacio individual para ordenar tus i: A one-on-one space to organize your ideas and turn what you imagine into a concrete offering.
el.Días y horarios a convenir: Days and times to be arranged
el.Tenés todo. Lo que falta es el hilo que: You have everything. What's missing is the thread that ties it together.
el.Casi siempre el problema no es que falte: Most of the time the problem isn't a lack of ideas, but having too many loose ones. A class you taught once, a workshop left half-built, something you'd love to offer but don't know how to name or how much to charge for.
el.Mi trabajo es ayudarte a <strong>mirar t: My job is to help you look at everything that already exists, find a common thread, put it in order and turn it into an offering that is clear, authentic and easy to communicate.

el.Que quieren armar su propia propuesta —c: Who want to build their own offering —classes, workshops, series, trainings— and not just teach hours in someone else's studio.
el.Que trabajan uno a uno y quieren ordenar: Who work one on one and want to organize their service, define their rates and find a way to talk about it.
el.Personas que desarrollan propuestas vinc: People developing offerings related to wellness and the holistic world who need to give them shape.
el.De la idea suelta a un plan de acción po: From a loose idea to a workable action plan.
el.Cada mentoría se arma según lo que neces: Each mentorship is shaped around what you need. These are the most common areas.
el.Creación de nuevas clases, talleres, cur: Creating new classes, workshops, courses or services.
The identity and distinctive edge of your project.
el.Cada encuentro termina con algo para hac: Every session ends with something to do.
el.Me contás dónde estás hoy y qué te gusta: You tell me where you are today and what you'd like to develop. I arrive at our session having read your material.

A summary and tasks after each one.
